items.title: ‘Surprised’ by Demand, Great Basin Goes Bigger on Nevada Natural Gas Expansion
items.summary: Great Basin Gas Transmission has upsized its northern Nevada natural gas expansion to nearly 950 MMcf/d and a 48-inch diameter pipe, leaving room to add compression later for growing demand from data centers, power generators and industrial users.

items.title: Why is Natural Gas Rallying in Peak Shoulder Season?
items.summary: Natural gas futures marched higher for a fourth consecutive session on Wednesday as traders eyed light production readings, bullish forecast trends and an intensifying tropical storm bearing down on the Gulf Coast.

items.title: Producers Take Breather, but Natural Gas Output Projected to Ramp Up as Winter Approaches

items.title: Isaias Track Skirts Most Gulf LNG as Coast Guard Sets Storm Conditions
items.summary: The US Coast Guard ordered storm preparations at lower Mississippi River ports on Wednesday as forecasters predict Tropical Storm Isaias to become a hurricane by Thursday on a track that could avoid most Gulf Coast LNG export capacity.

items.title: EIA Sees Lower Winter Natural Gas Heating Bills, With 1 Key Exception
items.summary: A mix of depressed prices and a potential for warmer weather in parts of the United States could mean homes that use natural gas for heating are in line for lower bills this winter, according to the US Energy Information Administration (EIA).

items.title: November Natural Gas Futures Blast Past $3.20 as Cooler Forecasts Stoke Buying
items.summary: US natural gas futures surged through midday trade on Wednesday as cooler longer range forecasts, expectations for a below-normal storage injection and short covering lifted the front of the curve.

items.title: Port Arthur LNG Commissioning Builds Ahead of 2027 Startup Push
items.summary: Sempra Infrastructure is advancing commissioning at Port Arthur LNG, with new startup activity bringing the Texas project closer to adding another major source of natural gas demand along the Gulf Coast.

items.title: Henry Hub Cash Follows NYMEX Higher as Appalachian Prices Struggle
items.summary: Natural gas cash pricing for next-day delivery was a mixed bag on Wednesday, with double-digit declines in Appalachia and the West offset by gains in the Gulf Coast and Southeast regions.

items.summary: Iraq devalued the dinar by 14.5% on Wednesday, setting the exchange rate at 1,520 per dollar after months of disruption to oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz cut into the government’s main source of revenue. The cabinet adopted the new exchange
